title: HostFormEditorViewDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one native form's editor state, at hostFormEditorViews/{formId}: the summary, the draft definition (its availability instants as Firestore timestamps, which the callable sent in its wire shape) and its validation issues, exactly as getOrganizerFormEditor returns them. Written by triggers on organizerForms and organizerFormDrafts; deleted when either is gone. Never response answers, payments or automation secrets, and never identity, permission or mutation authority: saves stay on updateOrganizerFormDraft, fenced by the draft revision in form.draftRevision.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels form view triggers)
